About this item
PARDZWORLD white drain pump assembly designed as a replacement part for compatible Bosch and Siemens front loading washing machines. Verify your existing pump assembly before ordering.
The drain pump assembly helps discharge used wash and rinse water from the washing machine during programmed draining operations when correctly installed in a compatible appliance.
Features a white pump housing with a blue removable filter cap, water inlet and outlet connections, mounting points and electrical connector. Compare every connection with your original assembly.
Before purchasing, match the existing pump body, hose connection orientation, filter cap, electrical connector, mounting locations and appliance model. Similar-looking pumps may have different specifications.
Suitable for replacing a compatible worn or faulty drainage pump assembly. Disconnect the washing machine from electricity and water before servicing. Professional technician installation is recommended.

Product Description
Enhance Your Washing Machine's Performance

Upgrade your Bosch or Siemens front-load washing machine with our specially designed drain pump. Engineered for powerful water drainage, quiet operation, and long-lasting durability, this pump ensures optimal performance. Easily match and install with the help of a qualified technician for a seamless laundry experience.

SPECIFIC COMPATIBILITY: This PARDZWORLD Drain Pump is exclusively designed to suitable for Bosch and Siemens Front Load Washing Machines. It ensures a precise fit and OEM-level performance for your premium laundry appliances.

EASY DIY INSTALLATION: Designed for a seamless "plug and play" setup. This replacement part allows you to restore your washing machine’s functionality quickly without the need for expensive technician visits.

Upgrade Your Washing Machine with Reliable Drainage

Enhance your Bosch or Siemens front-load washing machine's performance with our specially designed drain pump. Engineered for powerful water drainage and quiet operation, this durable component ensures efficient laundry cycles. Upgrade today for a smoother washing experience.

Enhance Your Washing Machine's Performance

Upgrade your Bosch or Siemens front-load washing machine with the PARDZWORLD Drain Pump. This powerful and durable component ensures efficient water drainage, operates quietly, and is designed to withstand long-term use. Engineered specifically for compatibility with select models, this pump offers reliable performance to keep your laundry routine running smoothly. For optimal results and safety, professional installation by a qualified technician is recommended.
